arStrings.szText: {icon:bullet,1.2} Casting a {c_important}Sigil{/c} Skill begins a Ritual for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds that grants {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 3"*100|x%|]{/c} damage which intensifies by up to {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 4"*100|%|]{/c} as the Ritual nears its end. Completing {c_important}Sigils{/c} progresses the Ritual by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value  1"]{/c} seconds and when the timer ends your next {c_important}Sigil{/c} Skill unleashes the Power Within, making your {c_important}Occult{/c} Skills free to cast for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"]{/c} seconds.
